headline: ITI Limited: Regulatory disclosure filed under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4)
sum: **ITI Limited's Under Secretary Finance Department (Kavitha L.) has filed a disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code Regulation 31(4)**, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares event, but substantive transaction details (acquirer, %, value) are not available in the public headline.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are mandatory when shareholding crosses 25%; practitioners must retrieve the full disclosure filing to assess whether this is an open offer trigger, exemption claim, or government disinvestment-related acquisition.
detail: The NSE filing constitutes formal regulatory notice under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires acquirers reaching or crossing 25% to disclose to the exchange and the target within prescribed timelines. Without the full PDF content or corroborating company press release, the identity of the acquirer, shareholding acquired, consideration, and deal structure remain unconfirmed.
